author: HBO Max
description:
Juju Green breaks down Lanterns Episode 5, “Lights Out,” with writer Justin Britt-Gibson and Kelly Macdonald, who plays Sheriff Kerry Kane. From the fall of Rushville to John Stewart and Hal Jordan's brutal fight, the episode takes Lanterns into some of its biggest emotional territory yet. 

Episode Breakdown:
✅ Justin Britt-Gibson reveals why the destruction of Rushville was always a major turning point for the season. 
✅ The writer discusses Green Lantern mythology, the show's cop-thriller influences, and the Guardians' complicated role in the story. 
✅ Justin breaks down John's decision to turn away from the ring and what it says about his sense of self. 
✅ Kelly Macdonald talks about building Sheriff Kerry Kane, including her Gotham City origins, Nebraska identity, and relationship with Hal Jordan. 
✅ Geeta Vasant Patel shares her perspective on the episode's biggest confrontations, including the John and Hal motel fight and John's decision to give back the ring.
